name: ferry-terminal-check-enabled
js: (()=>{const C=window.CITY;const r=C.waterfrontFerries;if(!C.waterfrontFerriesEnabled||!r)throw Error('waterfront ferries disabled');const s=r.stats;const need=[s.terminalBoxes>=3,s.ticketBooths===4,s.ticketCounters===8,s.ticketCanopies===1,s.directoryPanels===3,s.fingerPiers>=2,s.routes.length===3,s.terminalName==='JACK LAYTON FERRY TERMINAL'];if(need.some(v=>!v))throw Error('ferry terminal incomplete '+JSON.stringify(need));const ward=r.layout.routes.find(x=>x.id==='ward');if(!C.waterAt(ward.endpoint.x,ward.endpoint.z))throw Error('Ward endpoint not at water');if(C.waterAt(255,684)===false)throw Error('central channel not water');r.group.traverse(o=>{if(o.isInstancedMesh&&!o.instanceMatrix.array.every(Number.isFinite))throw Error('non-finite ferry transform '+o.name);});if(!r.group.children.some(m=>m.userData.role==='ticket-booth-glass'))throw Error('no glazed booths');console.log('[ferry-check] '+JSON.stringify({booths:s.ticketBooths,counters:s.ticketCounters,fingers:s.fingerPiers,berths:s.berths,text:s.textTextures,triangles:s.triangles}));})()

name: centre-deck-walk-nameboard-midday
js: (()=>{const a=window.__CITY_APP,C=window.CITY,r=C.waterfrontIslandArrivals,E=C.ISLAND_ARRIVAL_ESTIMATES;const d=r.layout.docks.centre;const x=d.deckAnchor[0],z=d.deckAnchor[1];a.selectMode('person');a.teleportTo(x,z,0);const g=a.controllerManager.getGroundHeight(x,z,'person');if(!(Math.abs(g-E.deckTop)<0.05))throw Error('centre walker ground '+g+' != deck '+E.deckTop);const s=C.islandArrivalSurfaceAt(x,z);if(!s||s.dockId!=='centre')throw Error('centre surface sampler mismatch');const f=d.boardFacing;a.cameraSystem.cinema=()=>({pos:[x+f[0]*7,E.deckTop+1.55,z+f[1]*7],look:[x,E.deckTop+1.85,z],fov:50});return {dock:'centre',teleportGround:g,deckTop:E.deckTop,boardFacing:f};})()
